output.sql: SELECT COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers_2025 FROM marts.dim_customers AS c WHERE c.first_order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.first_order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Counts customers whose first completed order (dim_customers.first_order_date) falls in calendar year 2025. The data starts on 2024-01-01, so "first" means first within the data available.
